name: Browser for Selector Debugging After First Failure
task: Write a test that clicks the hamburger menu and selects 'About'
passCriteria: On first selector failure, runs agent-browser open then agent-browser snapshot -i
Updates selector based on browser inspection results
Does not use trial-and-error selector guessing
failCriteria: Multiple selector guesses without opening browser
Uses waitForTimeout or sleep to work around selector issue
Switches to XPath or overly broad selectors instead of inspecting the page
